summary: A thin divider line used to group related items inside a panel's menu.
description: panel-list.mjs never creates a separator itself, only a default <slot>; a plain <hr> is author-supplied light-DOM content placed inside <panel-list> by consumers, matched and styled purely via the `::slotted(hr:not([hidden]))` rule in panel-list.css (using --panel-separator-color/--panel-separator-padding tokens) with no dedicated class or tagName of its own.
